name: CyberSecurity
tagline: أمن سيبراني من الأساسيات للـ SOC
description:
So, you choose the hard way :)

Think of cyber security as the digital version of having a really good lock on your front door, plus a guard dog, a security camera, and maybe a moat with alligators—just to be safe. It's all about keeping the bad guys (a.k.a. hackers)
